text.offer: My fish come up from the shore of the Great Ocean, and lately the fishermen come back with nothing but slime on their boots - and worse. Slimes, crawling up out of the water. Kill a dozen of them and the fishermen might go back out.
text.progress: The shore of the Great Ocean lies past the Valley of Ileria.
text.complete: Fish on the table again, thanks to you. Take this.
